message.content:
Here are some of the most popular books written by J.K. Rowling:

| Series | Title | Year Published | Notes |
|--------|-------|----------------|-------|
| **Harry Potter** | *Harry Potter and the Philosopher’s Stone* (U.S. title: *Sorcerer’s Stone*) | 1997 | First book in the series; introduces Harry, Hogwarts, and the wizarding world. |
| | *Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets* | 1998 | Harry returns for his second year; the mystery of the Chamber unfolds. |
| | *Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban* | 1999 | Sirius Black’s escape and the introduction of the Marauder’s Map. |
| | *Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire* | 2000 | The Triwizard Tournament and the return of Voldemort. |
| | *Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix* | 2003 | Harry’s fifth year and the rise of the Order. |
| | *Harry Potter and the Half‑Blood Prince* | 2005 | The backstory of Voldemort and the final battle. |
| | *Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows* | 2007 | The epic conclusion of the series. |
| **Cormoran Strike** (as Robert Galbraith) | *The Cuckoo’s Calling* | 2013 | A detective novel featuring private investigator Cormoran Strike. |
| | *The Silkworm* | 2014 | Strike investigates a missing author. |
| | *Career of Evil* | 2015 | Strike confronts a dangerous adversary. |
| | *Lethal White* | 2018 | A thriller involving a murder investigation. |
| | *Troubled Blood* | 2020 | Strike tackles a cold case. |
| | *The Ink Black* | 2023 | The latest entry in the Strike series. |
| **Other Works** | *The Casual Vacancy* | 2012 | Rowling’s first adult novel, a dark political drama set in a small town. |
| | *The Ickabog* | 2020 | A children’s fable published as a free online book during the COVID‑19 pandemic. |
| | *The Tales of Beedle the Bard* (illustrated by Rowling) | 2008 | A collection of wizarding fairy tales. |

These titles have sold millions of copies worldwide and have been adapted into blockbuster films, stage productions, and other media. If you’re looking for a particular genre or age group, let me know and I can narrow it down further!
